description: This Java interface defines a client API for interacting with image-related endpoints in a RESTful service, specifically for uploading, retrieving, updating, and deleting images associated with various entities. It includes methods for preparing file data URLs from files for upload purposes.

classes.name: ImagesApi
classes.description: Interface defining API methods for image management, including upload, retrieval, modification, and deletion of images linked to entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sends a POST request to upload an image as a data URL for a specified entity type and ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves images associated with an entity, allowing query parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing image for a specified entity with a new data URL.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes images associated with a specified entity.

methods.name: prepareFileUpload
methods.description: Static utility method to read a file, determine its media type, and convert it into a data URL suitable for uploading.
